label: Veda Oat
description: Warm oatmeal ground, near-black type, white product cards, deep herbal green and a copper accent. Built for a premium Ayurveda / wellness storefront whose products are copper, brass and steel instruments photographed on white — a coloured page background makes those photographs look pasted on, and pure white makes them disappear.
notes: The oatmeal (#ECE9E2) and the near-black/grey type pairing are taken from the reference the customer gave (allbirds.com, whose body background is exactly this colour) — it is what makes a catalogue of white-background product shots read as one considered set rather than a grid of cut-outs. The two brand colours come from the products themselves: deep herbal green for the Ayurveda context, copper for tamra shalaka, which most of this catalogue is made of. Contrast, all AA or better: text/bg 14.35:1, muted/bg 5.96:1, primary/bg 7.94:1, accent/bg 5.52:1, white/primary 9.63:1, white/secondary 16.1:1. Accent matters most because SiteRenderer paints 12px meta text with it. `secondary` is the dark BAND colour (Allbirds' #212121 footer), not a text colour. radius sm and spacious spacing on purpose: square-ish corners plus generous whitespace is the whole visual argument of the reference site, and cramped premium does not exist.
